metadata.accuracy: control status per ISW / Critical Threats assessments; coordinates are settlement centroids

properties.name: Pokrovsk
properties.status: Held by Ukraine, under sustained pressure
properties.note: Donetsk oblast rail junction and logistics hub. The focal point of Russia's slow-moving offensive for more than a year; repeated assaults have been repelled.

properties.name: Kupiansk
properties.note: Kharkiv oblast town on the Oskil River. Changed hands early in the war and remains an infiltration front.

properties.name: Kostiantynivka
properties.note: Southern anchor of the Sloviansk–Kramatorsk agglomeration and the next objective beyond Chasiv Yar.

properties.name: Chasiv Yar
properties.note: High ground west of Bakhmut. Whoever holds the ridge has observation over the approaches to Kostiantynivka.

properties.name: Toretsk
properties.note: Mining town on the southern flank of the Donetsk front.

properties.name: Siversk
properties.note: Northern shoulder of the Donetsk salient.

properties.name: Huliaipole
properties.note: Hinge between the Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia sectors.

properties.name: Orikhiv
properties.note: Launch point of Ukraine's 2023 southern counteroffensive; heavily fortified on both sides since.

properties.name: Vovchansk
properties.note: Northern Kharkiv oblast, a few kilometres from the Russian border.

properties.name: Zaporizhzhia NPP
properties.note: Europe's largest nuclear power station, at Enerhodar. All six reactors are shut down; the plant sits beside the line of contact and has repeatedly lost off-site power.

properties.name: Kerch Strait bridge
properties.note: The road and rail link between Russia and Crimea. Damaged in October 2022 and July 2023 and struck since; it remains the spine of Russian logistics into the peninsula.

properties.name: Kursk border sector
properties.note: Ukraine's August 2024 incursion was the first foreign ground operation on Russian soil since the Second World War. Russian counteroffensives have since reduced Ukrainian holdings; check a current source rather than trusting this marker.
